# Ajay Autade — Cloud & DevOps Engineer

> Personal site of Ajay Autade, a Cloud & DevOps Engineer based in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India. He works with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD, and is open to DevOps roles and freelance projects.

## Pages
- [Services](https://ajayautade.com/services): the six kinds of Cloud and DevOps work he takes on, each with its own page
- [Pricing](https://ajayautade.com/pricing): consultation and project prices in INR
- [Free tools](https://ajayautade.com/tools): infrastructure checkup, CIDR subnet calculator, cron expression explainer, Kubernetes resource calculator
- [Projects](https://ajayautade.com/projects): case studies of public projects, with architecture and source links
- [Blog](https://ajayautade.com/blog): technical articles ([RSS](https://ajayautade.com/feed.xml))
- [About](https://ajayautade.com/about): background, skills and how he works
- [Contact](https://ajayautade.com/contact): contact form and email
